headline: India opens its prized missile test range to Japan for the first time
label: NEWS
caption:
India is opening its missile test range to Japan for the very first time. 🚀

According to Firstpost, the move paves the way for potential collaboration on hypersonic technology between the two nations.

Defense ties have been strengthening as both countries look to expand security cooperation in the region.
